svg.title: Two tests of EEG prediction
svg.desc: Stylized abstract EEG line with one headline value 82 percent in random-window split and second value 64.6 percent in leave-one-person-out testing, explicitly different analysis summaries; no brain diagnosis or product claim.

g.text: THE SIGNAL IS NOT THE CLAIM
Different analyses, same small preprint dataset. Not a consumer audio trial.
